scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace=@linkpulse/common run build && npm --workspace=@linkpulse/events run build && npm --workspace=@linkpulse/logger run build
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm --workspaces run build --if-present
scripts.prisma:generate:all: prisma generate --schema=services/auth-service/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema=services/link-service/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema=services/analytics-service/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema=services/workspace-service/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema=services/domain-service/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema=services/billing-service/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema=services/notification-service/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently -k -n "gateway,auth,link,redirect,analytics,workspace,domain,billing,notification" -c "blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan,white,red,gray,blueBright" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:link" "npm run dev:redirect" "npm run dev:analytics" "npm run dev:workspace" "npm run dev:domain" "npm run dev:billing" "npm run dev:notification"
